exposure: Online format of Postpartum Bonding Questionnaire (PBQ) administration
Offline (paper-and-pencil) format of Postpartum Bonding Questionnaire (PBQ) administration
outcome: Reliability of the Postpartum Bonding Questionnaire (PBQ)
Factorial structure of the Postpartum Bonding Questionnaire (PBQ)
PBQ scores (overall, Rejection subscale, Anger subscale)
cohort: A total of 1,269 postpartum mothers, divided into an offline group attending a 40-day postpartum clinical appointment and an online group recruited during delivery admission who completed an online protocol 40 days postpartum.
finding: Online participants reported higher levels of stress, depressive symptoms, and poor mother-infant bonding (specifically on PBQ scores and its Rejection and Anger subscales) compared to offline participants, although the 4-factor solution of the PBQ showed good model fit for both samples.
